payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance metrics comparing the proposed similarity measure to BM25, indicating a clear improvement in average precision and NDCG scores.

claims.text: The proposed similarity measure outperforms BM25 by boosting average precision by 19% and 6% on TREC 2006 and 2007, respectively.
The proposed method achieves better NDCG scores than BM25, with improvements of 23% for NDCG@20, 23% for NDCG@5, and 25% for NDCG@10.
